items.quote: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
items.claim: Moses collected redemption money for the firstborn who exceeded the number redeemed by the Levites.
items.object: firstborn in excess of those redeemed by the Levites
items.mechanism: payment of redemption money as a substitute for Levite redemption

items.quote: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
items.claim: The redemption money taken from the firstborn of Israel came to 1,365 shekels, measured by the shekel of the sanctuary.
items.mechanism: redemption payment from the firstborn of the children of Israel

items.quote: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
items.claim: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, following the LORD's command.
items.mechanism: transfer to the priesthood by divine command
